end.summary:
Practised taking out common factors from algebraic terms.
Practised factorising x² + px + q by finding two numbers with the required sum and product.
Correctly handled common-factor examples, including 6x + 9 = 3(2x + 3).
Initially mixed up signs when p or q was negative; corrected this later by using two negative numbers.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised finding a common factor and pairing two numbers by their sum and product. They explained the common-factor method clearly and corrected the negative-sign mix-up later in the lesson. At home, practise a few examples such as x² - 7x + 12 and ask Arjun to check both the sum and product after factorising.
